description.en: From the movie "Dragon Ball Super: Broly", the strongest Saiyan Broly is now in 3D!

description.ja: • 特徴的な腰巻や衣装を新規造形で再現。
description.en: • The characteristic loincloth and costume are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: • 躍動感のある筋肉の造形により、強靭な肉体を表現。
description.en: • Expresses a strong body with dynamic muscle modeling.

description.ja: • 差し替え式の表情パーツと手首パーツにより力強いポーズを再現可能。
description.en: • Powerful poses can be recreated with interchangeable expression parts and wrist parts.

description.ja: • 特徴的な傷跡は曲面への追従性が高いマーキングシールで再現！
description.en: • Characteristic scars are reproduced with MarkingSeal, which has high followability to curved surfaces!

description.ja: • 表情パーツは「叫び」と「怒り」の２種付属。
description.en: • Two types of facial expression parts are included: "screaming " and " angry".

description.ja: • 悟空とベジータ用のダメージ顔が付属。
description.en: • Damaged faces for Goku and Vegeta are included.
